pr_title: Fix TextEdit breakpoint hover not hiding on mouse exit
pr_body:
- Fixes #65517

The area below the last line is no longer part of the last line's gutter.
The hovering, mouse cursor shape, and clicking gutter now uses the same logic.
Updating the gutter (add/remove/change size) now immediately updates the hover as well.
Added some gutter hover and click tests.
pr_comments:
Removed the CodeEdit mouse exit redraw, I don't think anything else was relying on it and I didn't notice any issues.

I don't think this can be cherry-picked. The breakpoint indicator did hide during 4.1 to 4.3 from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/78509, it was just recently re-introduced in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/65517.
This PR also relies on the changes #65517 made for the breakpoint hover, so without it this also may not fix the click logic and hover logic being different.
Removed cherrypick labels due to the reason mentioned by @kitbdev in above comment.

issue_context.title: The breakpoint hover indicator doesn't overlap with its click detection
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.alpha16

### System information

Ubuntu 20.04.3 LTS

### Issue description

1. One pixel to the right of a breakpoint, the cursor becomes an arrow, but a breakpoint can still be added.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85438892/189096121-f4681493-a479-4d6f-a2e8-b9a743003832.png)

2. ~This creates a breakpoint on the top line, even though the indicator is on the bottom line:~

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85438892/189095820-a1a5863d-f4de-464f-a936-07b257a3f5d1.png)

3. The indicator lags behind sometimes when the mouse exits the CodeEdit, or stays forever if the caret is not blinking.

4. ~Creating a breakpoint is possible if you go below the last line or above the first line, but the hover indicator doesn't reflect it.~

5. ~The hover indicator also activates when the mouse is outside of the main window on partially hidden lines:~

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85438892/190708964-e4187ca4-f4dc-4b56-aa35-f7f71572e461.png)

6. ~It doesn't work with word wrap.~

### Steps to reproduce

Place your mouse exactly like in the photos

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
comments: In general, I suggest making the hover area for breakpoint buttons span the whole line's height. This makes them easier to click quickly, without having to spend too much time aiming.
That is the case presently, but sometimes the indicator doesn't show the correct line where a breakpoint is about to be toggled.

Point 3 is caused because the text editor doesn't redraw when the cursor exits it. It usually disappears shortly after because the caret blink causes a redraw.

This also causes the bookmark indicator to take a brief moment to update after pressing Shift.
Point 3 has been reintroduced at some point during the 4.4 development cycle. Even caret blinking doesn't cause the redraw this time though.

- Related https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/93036
- Some of these were fixed in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/92865

The indicator should now match where the breakpoint will be placed. So points 2, 4, and 6 are fixed.
Though for point 4 maybe it should not allow placing a breakpoint if it is past the last line and above the first?
I think point 5 is fixed as well, though it is harder to see because of point 3.

Just tested and indeed, what you've mentioned has been addressed. I scratched these out in the issue now.

At the same time, 3 has gotten much worse, and I found that there's an instance of 1 that's still problematic so I've edited it. So only these two issues remain. 🎉
- All remaining issues should be fixed in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/101613

review_comments: The hover update is why I added a `queue_redraw()` in CodeEdit's NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_EXIT, so that one shouldn't be needed anymore.
